shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i \"view transition|transition type|view-transition-name|startViewTransition|directional\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,470p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '470,550p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,360p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,420p' app/globals.css"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts && sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(r.version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\" && node -e \"const n=require('next/package.json'); console.log(n.version)\" && rg -n \"interface ViewTransition|type ViewTransition|transitionTypes\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next/dist/client node_modules/next/dist/shared | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && rg -n 'ViewTransition' node_modules/react node_modules/react-dom node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,160p'"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'experimental|react' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | sed -n '1,240p' && rg -n 'viewTransition' node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '560,620p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && sed -n '950,995p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && rg -n \"experimentalReact|react experimental|reactExperimental|view transition\" node_modules/next/dist/server node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"transitionIndicator|gestureTransition|taint.*experimental|needsExperimentalReact|experimental.*React\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"bundledReactChannel|react\\"'$|react-dom" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | sed -n '"'1,180p' && rg -n \"transitionIndicator\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '640,685p' node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js && rg -n \"react:.*next/dist/compiled|createVendoredReactAliases|reactAliases\" node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '280,360p' node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/next/dist/server/route-modules/app-page/vendored/ssr/entrypoints.js && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/server/route-modules/app-page/vendored/rsc/entrypoints.js"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,340p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && tail -n +1 app/globals.css | sed -n '1,520p' && git diff -- app"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && rg -n \"product-image-morph|content-loading|nav-forward|prefers-reduced-motion\" .next/static .next/server -g '*.css' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/gallery-home-headers http://127.0.0.1:3000/ -o /tmp/gallery-home.html && curl -sS -D /tmp/gallery-detail-headers http://127.0.0.1:3000/product/classic-sneakers -o /tmp/gallery-detail.html && sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/gallery-home-headers && sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/gallery-detail-headers && rg -o 'product-image-classic-sneakers|nav-forward|content-loading-out|Classic Sneakers|Back to products' /tmp/gallery-home.html /tmp/gallery-detail.html | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '1,360p'"
/bin/bash -lc "git check-ignore -v .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts || true && git ls-files --error-unmatch next-env.d.ts >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s\\n' "'$?'
/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -depth -type f -delete && find .next -depth -type d -empty -delete && unlink tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && unlink next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check'
